# Covariance Matrix

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Treat the rows \[1,2\], \[2,4\], \[3,6\] as paired observations. Their sample covariance matrix contains 1, 2, 2 and 4.

## What this example demonstrates

Treat the rows \[1,2\], \[2,4\], \[3,6\] as paired observations. Their sample covariance matrix contains 1, 2, 2 and 4.
